value.answer: Tomorrow's cooler, about 65°F with partly sunny skies. Clouds build later, with a 30% chance of rain after 3pm and a possible shower in the evening. Tomorrow night drops to the low 40s, maybe the 30s. Breezy from the north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph.
